snippet.title: Sonic Advance: Unnamed - Cosmo Gameplay (SAGE 2025 Demo)
snippet.description:
Formerly known as Sonic Advance Neo.
-
The game: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-advance-unnamed-sage-2025-demo.2786
-

Sorry the controls/moves list on the SAGE page isn't very descriptive - it's hard for me to stop after i start explaining things and nobody wants to read all that, let's be honest.

My Sonic playthrough went terrible, so I'm uploading this first. I dont know why I get so bad at the game every time I try to record gameplay...

I'll upload a video for each character. I planned on showing each character on a different stage, but I dream of Razor & Zenon making a playthrough video of my game. Maybe not THIS build (LOL) but one day...
Anyway I think I'm going to pause updates this month. Super busy weeks ahead. I do want to check out the other SAGE games though. 

So far I've only got to play Sonic Definitive, Super Duper Amy Rose, and Sonic Only Up. They're pretty increidble. This year's batch looks amazing so far.
